rows.text: This view hasn't changed at all, has it?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The hometown in your memories never changes, but when you return to your senses, you realize that fate has already stolen the time away.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Welcome to the trail of "Genesis," [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Seems like the weight of "memories" from thirty million cycles really made me grow up.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But if I keep growing, I might be taller than you, right, [Trailblazer]? Then I'm really looking forward to that.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Me too. Thirty million departures. Thirty million farewells.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Those heavy "memories" will all become the soil upon which the new world shall bud, and this time... We will make it bloom with a different flower.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Indeed. The Scepter's extrapolations have reached their end, but the process of "Genesis" has only just begun.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The path ahead will no longer rely on emotionless programs. It'll be decided by the will of humankind.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Before you arrived, I kept wondering... beyond the veil of Aedes Elysiae, what kind of Amphoreus is being born?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I can see fragments of it when I close my eyes... The friends who walked alongside us have all moved on toward their respective destinies.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Some turning into pillars of the world, supporting the Sky and the Ocean. Others sowing Reason, laying down the Law, and with gentle hands lifting newborns into the light.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Death and Strife are no longer feared by people, and Trickery has become the innocent games of children.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: All beings living ordinary and peaceful lives within the net woven by Romance and Passage.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: There's no black tide, no Flame-Chase, and no Destruction. The world on the other side of the sea is one bathed in sunlight.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Like a happy and carefree childhood, the "Era Chrysea" in this cycle will last for millennia, until it reaches the moment decided by the prophecy...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Light Calendar 4931, Month of Freedom, the moment belonging to Worldbearing.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Are you ready to answer the call of the world, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Then go, and pen the Throne of Worlds' first stroke... for this world made from countless wishes.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You say that, but it's gonna be ages till we reach Light Calendar 4931.
Our consciousnesses can converse with each other across the heavens and the earth, possibly due to the influence of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: I can make use of the crevices of Time, but surely [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng won't have to wait around for a few thousand years... right?
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Our consciousnesses can converse with each other across the heavens and the earth, possibly due to the influence of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: That won't be necessary. We can simply sleep, and the "Chronocognitive Anchor" will wake us up.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: Veil of Evernight? Pillar of Stone?
I didn't expect you'd both be here.
That's right. We've both become a part of the new world. Just waiting for you now.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: We've both become a part of the new world ages ago. You're the last, slowpoke.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: I am now connected with this Earth, and I can feel the breath of every mountain range...
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: I see that the tallest among them is named "Okhema," and the form of the holy city is already taking shape.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: In other words, your stage is almost set. Do you wanna take a leaf out of Kephale's book and make some prophecies before your nap?
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: But we're not the only ones who have changed.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: The Chronocognitive Anchor just transmitted a message stating that "Irontomb" has reacted to the "Era Nova."
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: The moment when [Trailblazer] bore the weight of thirty million cycles of "memories"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Was probably also when the Scepter devoured thirty million cycles of Destruction.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: It's bound to happen, and I've long prepared for that.
Y'know, [Trailblazer]... You don't have to shoulder this world all on your own.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: After someone boards the Express, the word "alone" ceases to exist. So as we reach the end of time, no one will be left to face it alone.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Dan Heng and I came here to specifically tell you that.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Remember, this world is not a burden you bear alone.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: It's a journey we Trailblaze together, alongside all of the Express.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: Seriously, can't you let me be the protagonist for once?
There'll be plenty of time for you to show off in the future.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: She meant to say that a hero only turns up at the most pivotal moment.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Alright, it's time for Dan Heng and me to go have a super long nap. Look after this world for us, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: The road ahead is long, but we'll be waiting for you at the end.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: We'll definitely meet again.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: (Let's take one more look at the other side of the sea before we set off.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Aedes Elysiae is so quiet.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Mmm. Just like how I remember.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Here we are once more.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (The scent of the black tide is now completely calm.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (At last, the starting point of thirty million cycles... has finally welcomed...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Its first end.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And the final end, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I can't hear his voice. There are no flowers there that bloom for him, nor is there a star that is his.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Phainon... is the only one who didn't reach the new world.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: He gave everything to obtain this momentary peace.
Look. The golden light that shone upon the Grove still meanders between heaven and earth, like the prophecies of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It has to be a sign he left behind. It points towards the Destruction... and the deepest night.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Do you still remember what I asked you at this exact spot the last time we set off?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "[Trailblazer], are you ready to become a hero?"
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You were still burdened by the weight of Worldbearing back then, still unsure of the role you were meant to play. But now... everyone has already given you the answer.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The "heroes" of legends were just at the right place at the right time when the world needed a hero.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Just like how your arrival kick-started Amphoreus's fate once more.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A person's personality is their destiny.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Together, we'll all make it to the best possible ending.
"We." "Best." ...Those are such beautiful words.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Thank you, [Trailblazer]. I was also trying to cheer myself up with what I said.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: After all, before we truly compose the end of this story, I must also pluck up the courage to head off with you...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And face...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A "memory" that I have forgotten for too long... and have denied for too long.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Currently, beyond the sky...
It's so dark. What is this place...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Great Tomb of the nameless Titan. The deepest recesses of "memory."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Also... the place where "Cyrene" was born.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Weren't you born in Aedes Elysiae?
My apologies, [Trailblazer]. The more memories I got back along the way, the more I felt that something wasn't right.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: There's a sort of anxiety I can't get rid of. It's like when I was back in Aedes Elysiae, when the reflections in the water always made me wonder... which is the real me? The one reflected in the water, or the one standing on the shore?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But I finally get it now.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Look, [Trailblazer]. The words on that wall are the answer.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "One, two, three, four, five, six, seven"...
"Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That rhymeless tune is the lullaby of little fairies.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "As always, I'll read this book to you..."
"That way, it won't just be 'Cyrene's' memories alone."
I've always thought that I was the narrator of the Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But as it turns out, the narrator...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...is also the most devoted "audience."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What do you mean...
I believe in every version of you.
I'm the one who tells the story.
Thank you, [Trailblazer]. "Every single Cyrene"... That sounds so kind.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That's pretty forward of you, you know? Still... thank you, [Trailblazer]. That's very reassuring.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: At the moment of Era Nova, I was enveloped by the texture of "memories." Within the glistening crystal, I saw countless "Cyrenes"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: As well as countless versions of me.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This is the final puzzle piece of the "memories," [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A prison born of the Erudition. A grave annihilated in the Destruction.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That unknown solitary god, the Thirteenth Titan who should not exist...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The first nouspore, the Demiurge... is right here.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The Chronocognitive Anchor is sending a signal... Everyone, time to move out.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Did [Trailblazer] and the others make it?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Let me go over the plan one more time, just in case: You'll enter Amphoreus, reunite with your {RUBY_B#[Trailblazer], March 7th, Dan Heng}three separated companions{RUBY_E#}, and try to locate Irontomb from within the world.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Who are you taking with you?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The fate of the universe hangs in the balance. We can't afford any slip-ups. I suggest everyone, except Pom-Pom, join the fight.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: We do need to be prepared for all possible contingencies. I have no objection to this.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'll do whatever I can.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Meanwhile, Screwy and I will continue attacking the Demiurge Matrix, that is, the Scepter's kernel, from the outside.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: With our two-pronged attack, we'll turn this hunk of metal into scrap for sure. Now, we just wait for those two to get back.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Oh, and just like that, they're here!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Sorry to keep you waiting. With Planet Screwllum's help, the formation of the cosmic alliance to counter Irontomb is progressing smoothly.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The cosmos has set its sights on Amphoreus, and now it's just waiting for... the first shot.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Well then, let's not waste any more time. Fourth Mirror!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: It's my time to shine! Finally off the bench!
rows.speaker: Fourth Mirror

rows.text: Initiating Thought Refraction. Please read the safety protocols carefully...
rows.speaker: Fourth Mirror

rows.text: Huh?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Nah, just kidding! I've already checked the agreement box for everyone. And now, destination: Amphoreus!
rows.speaker: Fourth Mirror

rows.text: Three, two, one... Launch!
rows.speaker: Fourth Mirror

rows.text: ...The flow of memoria is so heavy here.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Unlike Penacony's Dreamscape, this place has built up a true epic measured in millennia.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: The Vortex of Genesis, where all myths begin and end. And in this new world created by [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The infinite cycles have been broken.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Let's set up the Trailblaze beacon and establish contact with the outside world.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...I'll leave it to you then. It'd be better for me to not show myself in front of the Garden of Recollection.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: And Mr. Sunday, you probably shouldn't show yourself either.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Agreed.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It's clear that each party still has qualms about everything.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The clash between Destruction and Erudition isn't just about the fate of the cosmos. It's a moment for all factions to reshuffle their cards.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You can never be too careful when battling a Lord Ravager. All are equal in matters of life and death.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: In any case, we can only hope for the best in all that's to come.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's about time we dive into the Vortex and see what Amphoreus looks like on the inside.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Unbelievable. All the residents of the holy city have gathered here.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This isn't just a gathering. It's a pilgrimage. The people's expressions are resolute, devout... as if waiting for a miracle to descend.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: That colossal deity... is [Trailblazer]. {M#He}{F#She} has become the pillar of the world.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Surprisingly authentic... Being this serious is quite unlike {M#his}{F#her} usual style.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "Those people didn't disappear. Instead, they've answered the call of the prophecy and come to witness [Trailblazer]'s awakening."
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "Our good buddy now bears the weight of the entire world, and every breath they take is intertwined with Amphoreus's destiny."
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Awakening? Has [Trailblazer] fallen into slumber?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Yeah. After all, with such a huge time dilation between inside and outside the Scepter, this was the only way we could wait for everyone."
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "Time watches over yesterday. Earth guards today. And when the Trailblaze steps into Amphoreus once more, the slumbering Deliverer shall awaken..."
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "And then, bring the prophecy of 'tomorrow' to this world."
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "Come on, everyone! Let's get closer to {M#him.}{F#her.}"
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "Watch how the Worldbearing prophecy changes this world!"
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: It seems the kids are already miles ahead of us at this stop.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: All the more reason we can't afford to slow down our pace. Let's go witness this moment for ourselves.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Majestic... Speaking of which, I once caught a glimpse in [Trailblazer]'s memory of {M#him}{F#her} transformed into a towering Tatalov. Could it be...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "No way. That was just a nice dreamscape! ...Uh, at least nice for [Trailblazer]..."
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: If they are the "Throne of Worlds" who bears the weight of this world... perhaps they could guide a traveler still wandering among the stars.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Hey, since when did you get all pious? [Trailblazer]'s advice sounds pretty silly sometimes, you know.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: The so-called "fool" and the "world"... are merely a step apart.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Citizens, behold: Our last Titan, the Worldbearing [Trailblazer], is about to awaken!
rows.speaker: Serena

rows.text: O ancient god, your loyal subjects, bewildered followers, and fearless comrades-in-arms have all knelt before your throne.
rows.speaker: Serena

rows.text: Awaken from your eternal slumber and bestow upon the world your divine prophecy!
rows.speaker: Serena

rows.text: Please guide us! Show us how to embrace this beloved world as we welcome that distant dawn!
rows.speaker: Citizens

rows.text: To walk the path of a mortal as a god. Or to bear a divine burden as a mortal...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: {M#He}{F#She} will give us the answer.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "But I am not the Deliverer..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Rather, I am the Nameless who dwells among mortals..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That voice is definitely [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "I heard... your prayers..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "The {RUBY_B#Destruction}Coreflames{RUBY_E#} flickered and dimmed... and the age of the gods met its end..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "So flow, golden blood... flow..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "I'll bestow it upon you... returning it to the true masters of this world..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Stand with me... and become heroes...!"
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is this...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yes, it's the miracle [Trailblazer] brought to Amphoreus...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Of course, it would manifest in the form of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Golden blood raining down like a storm! The prophecy has descended, and the Titan commands us not to be supplicants...
rows.speaker: Serena

rows.text: But to become heroes of rebellion, to face that destined calamity, the Destruction, head-on!
rows.speaker: Citizens

rows.text: "The prophecy of the 'Deliverer' means nothing to me now. It belongs in the hands of someone far more fitting..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Someone like... all of you..."
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "In the name of {RUBY_B#Bearer of Chaos}Khaslana{RUBY_E#}, let us depart and march towards the light!"
rows.speaker: Throne of Worlds, [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's neither protection nor salvation. As always...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: There's no need for totems or myths. Humanity's most primal faith is that instinct named "survival."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Let's go, everyone. Someone has already sounded the horn of departure.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Explore, understand, establish, and connect...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Together, let us blaze a trail for the destiny of this world.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Is it just me, or does this Demiurge Matrix...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Feel completely dead? It's nothing like how the Memokeeper described it.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The environmental readings are all wrong. Conclusion: this must be what the "kernel" actually looks like in the real world.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: What did Zandar do to the Scepter...?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "At the end of light, there must be silence. Certain, pure, and absolute darkness."
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Not the time to quote the Lord of Silence. Bad omen. Either way, we have to press on...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Until we uncover the truth behind the 13th Titan.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The buried past is the key to stopping Irontomb. That is, if it even exists.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Board the Mistletoe and continue the flight
Pause the flight
The one walking beside me... had always been...
Yes. The "seed" within memories, the one {RUBY_B#PhiLia093}"Cyrene"{RUBY_E#} held in her hands and watered with "lament"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So, at the end, that first ripple...
I'm sorry, I don't know. If I don't even want to believe in the answer, then how am I supposed to answer you...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Should I call you Mem? Cyrene? Or...?
Do you remember that I was also worried about this when we first set out?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I will, Cyrene.
Thank you, [Trailblazer]. Your kindness is always just right.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Of course. It's her blessing to you.
You can't be separated from her, no matter what.
You are one of the keys to defeating Irontomb.
A lost "heart" needs to be placed back into its "body."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If "mind" and "body" become one...
There may be a way to stand up against Irontomb.
You have always been and will always be a member of the Flame-Chase.
That way, I can also put aside all my worries and... truly become "Cyrene."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Let's move forward together with the Trailblaze.
Together, let's write the finale.
Zandar says the Demiurge never existed. Who actually buys that? You can erase the records, but not the truth.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: It vanished too cleanly. No traces, like someone yelling, "Look! There's nothing here!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Too bad I'm the type who can't resist digging deeper. Looks like I'll be counting on you again, Screwy. Let's tear this system inside out.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Always happy to help. But as your academic partner, I have to ask—
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Herta, what if we fail?
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Let's say the Demiurge really doesn't exist. Do you have a backup plan?
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Backup plan? Of course. If we can't find the key...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: We turn the "lock" into the key.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: That plan's cost... is incalculable. It shouldn't even be on the table.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Then let's hope we never have to use it.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: There's no point worrying about the end just yet. One step at a time. Let's go. We don't want to leave the others waiting.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You brought what I asked for, right?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "A butterfly has to land on the branch before it can dance."
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: We'll need a wide, open platform before "her" entrance.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Just use that thing over there, Zag, Z...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Oh? A classic nuclear heat engine? Classy choice.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Just a personal preference. Her name's Mistletoe.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Every flower in your garden's got a bit of poison, huh?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Also a personal preference.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: It reminds me of the last time, when we tangled with that Punklordian brat. What did she call this kind of infiltration tool again? Right, Dirty Data Shell. It wraps around the kernel to fool even top-tier firewalls.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But yours is way too clean. Not even a hint of real-world grit.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Herta, your tone is unusually emotional.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Suggestion: Let's get back to the topic at hand.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: I thought we were done with that conversation.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Unfortunately, current conditions won't let me ignore any variables. Especially the most important one: your will.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Irontomb never stops, it is evolving faster than any of our worst projections.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Every Instant in the Aeon's calculation is like a sword hanging over the cosmos. Every move humanity makes could speed up its arrival.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Which is exactly why we can't mess this up.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: And now Droidhead wants to hand down judgment to the poor cosmos again: Borderstar Trade War, Emperor's War, Rubert's death... every time THEIR Instant arrived, it meant another bloodbath for humanity.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But in this ultimate battle of Erudition, you and I are supposed to be players, not pawns.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: If you choose to burn yourself out as a "resource," then everything we've worked for means nothing.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Herta, the cosmos won't just stand by and let a genius throw their life away...
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: And neither will I.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: No need to kill the mood. This is why we're here, isn't it? We need to find the Demiurge and that lost key.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I'm not here to be a "Deliverer." I just want to beat Zandar and Droidhead.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Right now, I just need to know: are you with me?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Of course. Time to board. After you.

rows.text: Alright, then write it like this: Cipher, Trickery's Traveler... All she ever wanted was for there to always be water in deserts and gold in fertile soil, and for even a thief to steal their way into legend!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Here, take the Coin of Whimsy. When it's time to make a quick getaway, just toss it high into the sky."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "And for all you latecomers out there, listen up: She might've been a bit greedy and a bit of a liar... but she never went back on her word!"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Well, well. If it isn't the little prince himself."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "It's been a while, Lady Cifera."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: "It's not everyday we get to walk the same road."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "We're one player short. When's Princess Homebody showing up?"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: So even this vessel... you've forged into a shackle?
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: I'm glad to see you again...
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: Castorice...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Looking back, I had only one act of "salvation" to my name, and only one life I ever saved.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: To bring hope to a world so vast with these hands... Even in dreams, it always felt like too much to ask for.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: We are saving countless lives.
Mm. I... won't forget.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: Flame Reaver? Why is he here?
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: This is the first Khaslana, and Lord Phainon's deepest wound.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: He remembered everything he bore through the fires of his fury, but when the embers faded, all that remained was cold regret.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: I've restrained countless vessels like this across endless cycles. But this one... the pain he carried runs deeper than any I've known.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: "Maybe he's been waiting here just for us."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Waiting for his former 'enemies' to stand before him again."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: What answer does he hope for from us?
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: "Well, obviously..."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: "Even if I had to go through hundreds of billions of cycles again, I would still entrust my weakness to you."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: "So, let go of your regret, comrade. Its purpose is served. You don't need it anymore."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: "Hey, I'm not that accommodating, y'know. You've never once pulled your punches. Ever heard of going easy on a lady?"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "So pull yourself together, will you? If you freeze up during the final battle, the whole cosmos is gonna have a good laugh."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...Yes. Please trust in us, wandering soul.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: Across thirty million cycles, the radiance of every Flame-Chaser now shines bright enough to illuminate the path ahead.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: I ask you to rest here...
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: And may this grieving soil bear the bloom of acceptance.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: No earthquakes... It's surprisingly quiet.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Perhaps Khaslana has found his peace.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: There's another possibility. This may not be the only seal he left behind.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: Then, I suppose it's my time to set out with you.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: Please take this Antila flower with you. I believe that if anything could speak for "Castorice"...
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: This ordinary, resilient bloom would be more than enough.
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: Perhaps you remember, Lord Mydei. In that lifetime when you traveled with [Trailblazer], you once told me...
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: "Control what little you can, and when fate's inescapable grasp comes..."
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: "Resist it with the strength of your mighty will."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I think I've done it. I've stood tall and walked among the Flame-Chasers...
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: Casting off the name of death — Castorice, Servant of the Afterlife — may her name be etched into the stars...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "And then, live as a human..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "And die as one."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Why so sentimental?"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Sorry, force of habit."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "That's a big one. So, who's up for a show?"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Not budging an inch, huh? Really, Gray Mystery? I leave you alone for a bit and you're already this rusty?"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Speaking of which, Miss Cipher, do Dolosians... all like spherical things?"
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Of course we do... Wait, that's not the point!"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Isn't the real issue that this thing's in the way?"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Seems like something got mixed up.
Oh right, it's my turn to shine now?
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Watch this! The fresh power of Time!
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Remember Oronyx's Prayer?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Of course I do! C'mon, give me some credit...
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "Lift the beddings of memory..."
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "—and stir up ripples of past reverie!"
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: There's a whole garden down here...?
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Incredible. The energy in the earth's veins here... It's completely different.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: "This is the sweet dream Lady Cipher wove for him..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "A peaceful, gentle new world."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Look, the blade down here's already snapped...
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Just like his mind, shattered and broken.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: But that light... it looks familiar...
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes, it's the {RUBY_B#the Destruction's divine blood}world-cleansing blood{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: Still shimmering... after all this time?
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: "This roundabout way of doing things... is definitely him."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: "Golden light... tracing the way home..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Shame our destination's the exact opposite of the one in your poem."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: All the "pink" lights have finally come together.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: I've been waiting so long for you! Grayie, Dannie, and...
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: So that makes... three adorable pink-haired girls!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Told ya. Let someone else say that kinda stuff.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Huh? Marchie? I think I prefer Sevie.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Huh... you've actually got a point!
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer]'s eyes really lit up...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'm glad we're all getting along so well!
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: Hyacine, did you awaken this golden light?
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: That's Lord Phainon's lingering divinity. The Sky merely reflected its tracks.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: The golden blood has not faded. We... should respond in kind.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: That's one huge harp...
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: The strings tremble as the people on the surface wage war and cry out.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: Miss Clementine, Mr. Krateros, and countless others who have heeded [Trailblazer]'s call... guided by the rainbow. They're sending back good news, all to the same tune...
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: "Amphoreans need not bow, even when destiny is unveiled."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I knew you could all hear it too.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: Standing here, the sky feels wider than ever. It's no longer a towering wall, but a shore within reach.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: We'll take every name there with us, won't we?
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: An epic is shaped by the lives it carries. That much is beyond doubt.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: Or as you've said before: Right now, all that matters is to believe.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: Begin the ritual.
Then... I guess that's my little wish fulfilled.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: Pluck the strings, Hyacine, Healer of the Sky. May the seven-hued melody weave a rainbow, bringing a rosy-fingered dawn to the children of humanity.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "When the rainbow rises across the horizon, even the darkest clouds of destiny shall scatter."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The golden harp stands silently, yearning for those who came after to strum its strings.
Respond to Phainon's presence.
Phainon... can you hear me?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The world responded with silence, just like that man. But this silence wasn't born of emptiness — it was the hoarse roar of a martyr.
The golden harp stands silently. Phainon awaits your touch upon its strings.
Whoa! There's another one!
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trianne

rows.text: Over here, too...
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trinnon

rows.text: Lady Tribios?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Wow! Y—You're Little Reney?
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trianne

rows.text: You look so... grown-up all of a sudden!
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trianne

rows.text: She is not the Cyrene we remember...
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trinnon

rows.text: She is the Demiurge, Titan of Genesis, the one destined to work miracles alongside the heroes.
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trinnon

rows.text: The miracle needs you too.
Our assured victory is more than just a miracle.
You see, weird stuff keeps popping up everywhere!
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trianne

rows.text: They're so scary, and so sad! Good thing Trianne's wings are amazing, or we would've been swallowed up!
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trianne

rows.text: Scrolls filled with horrifying content... [Trailblazer], shall we take a look?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "The melody... it's changed..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "He heard the voices of the people, but could no longer respond with the same ardor."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Like a bird drawn home by instinct..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "It takes flight, and finds its way to him."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Even this pure land is being tainted by the Destruction."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Shall we seek another way? His wisdom may be what we need."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You're here. Sooner than I expected.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: So, all along, the Demiurge was you...
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: The pink mammal beside [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: Begin the ritual.
Your classification is pretty spot-on, Professor Anaxa...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Well, the Sages of the Grove do call him the Titan with the sharpest eye in Amphoreus."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Say the ones who keep dumping every problem child on me.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: "They also say that Titans are way better at raising kids than the Caprists."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "With great power comes great responsibility. I'm sure you know just how to guide them, right?"
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "It shouldn't be too hard for someone with your insight."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Exactly. Alright, gather yourselves. It's time for a pop quiz.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: Whoa, this is way more hardcore than the happy-go-lucky stuff at Paperfold University.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: The final battle is upon us, and the reinforcements still can't get through. No matter how many times I tell him, he just can't seem to manage the rear line properly.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: See those crystals? They carry the "wishes of deliverance," like insects trapped in amber and resin.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: This is the task Phainon left behind: Retrace the path once taken, draw forth those wishes from the crystals, and carry them into the final battle.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: I've tried, but I can't move them alone. And as for why, well, I'm sure you all know the answer.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: "Hmm, the conviction to save the world weighs far heavier than the world itself."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: In other words, as The Hero Within his heart...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This challenge is practically made for [Trailblazer], isn't it?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Who turned off the lights!? This pop quiz even has dramatic effects now?
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "Endless darkness... that is where wishes begin."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "But with just a glimmer of light, we can illuminate this lonely world."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The light's spreading.
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "These creatures... they're everywhere..."
rows.speaker: Echo of Deliverance

rows.text: "Someone... anyone... where are you..."
rows.speaker: Echo of Deliverance

rows.text: His very first wish was simply to become his village's little hero...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: He'll never forget what set him on this path.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That's the ray of hope. Just like the wishes he gathered, it's grown ever more insatiable.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: "WHY... WHY IS THIS HAPPENING!?"
rows.speaker: Echo of Deliverance

rows.text: "The blaze was still not enough. It had to be fed..."
rows.speaker: Echo of Deliverance

rows.text: "Only by... feeding the flames... can we melt... that hopeless future."
rows.speaker: Echo of Deliverance

rows.text: The echo in his heart still lingers.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: Deliverer, take the wish of Worldbearing with you first.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: Bear the wish of Worldbearing.
We only have half of the mark. Where's the other half?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Take this. I'll bring you to the next test.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: That massive tome you're holding must have room for one more scholar, I presume?
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: Of course. It can hold the whole world.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Then give me a lift, would you? I'd rather save my energy and use the time to think.
rows.speaker: Bough of Rift, Anaxagoras

rows.text: "Even gods shouldn't skip exercise, you know?"
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Miss Hyacine... is right."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Then, with the Trailblaze as witness, the stars shall remember how Anaxagoras refuted the gods...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: No need for that. Anaxa, Scholar of Reason... keeping it simple makes it easier for future minds to question.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "Go. The closing act is still far ahead."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "NeiKos496, still resisting?"
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Hehe, Little Gray, this time, let's give it everything we've got!
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Trianne

rows.text: "We're here. The second test site."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: I wonder what kind of "wish" we'll see this time...
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: "I'm afraid it's quite the opposite."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "This time, we'll face his despair."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Despair?
So, I need to walk this path too?
"That's right. You'll have to walk this path too."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "What, are you afraid?"
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: The other half of the weight of Worldbearing lies at the end of this path.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Relax now, [Trailblazer]. Take a deep breath.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Come on. Let's make it quick.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: "If you're ready, begin the ritual and retrace the steps he once took."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Looks like we'll be walking through the darkness this time.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Exactly. It's no longer about mending broken wishes..."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "But shattering the frozen despair."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: The other half of Worldbearing...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: As promised, [Trailblazer], take it now.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Bear the despair of Worldbearing.
"At last, you've released him from the wishes he carried for so long."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "And quenched the despair kindled by his wrath."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "When both 'light' and 'shadow' are claimed by those who follow, his true form shall emerge..."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: "The 'blank statue'... is finally free."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: That smiling child in the "memories"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Let him come with us, laughing to the very end.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: My wish...
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: Is to fulfill everyone else's wishes!
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: From now on, the world no longer needs a tomorrow promised by prophecies.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Whoa...
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: So tall, so cool! Just like the "hero" on the oracle cards!
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: Heh...
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: It's because he is the very embodiment of a "hero."
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Hmm... Who are you?
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: So, you've returned to a "blank space."
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: But for me, this is the 33,550,337th time, and the last time, that I meet you at the end of the world.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: They're already on their way. Should they cross paths with me... I imagine things may spiral out of control.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Thirty million... what? And who are "they"?
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: Pay it no mind, child. Keep looking there... What do you see in him?
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Mmm...
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: It looks like just a statue, but...
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: It's weird... He's warm. Like, really warm.
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: Why not listen as well?
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Um... I hear something...
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: There are cracks all over him... and they're making this sound... like someone's groaning. It's scary.
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: Is he... Is he gonna fall apart?
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: How unfortunate, child.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: This man would rather fall to pieces than fall to his knees.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: You might think of me as... a sculptor. Across all my years, I only completed two pieces.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Others may call them "masterpieces." But only I know how many regrets they truly hold.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Regrets?
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: My first creation left me long ago. This second one... it was meant to be perfect.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: I believed it with all my heart... until this very moment.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: I don't get it. Are you saying you've changed your mind?
rows.speaker: Blank Wish

rows.text: I won't change. But I'll admit this: Those twelve stones, unpolished as they are, are a thousand times more exquisite than any statue.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: It's as if they are mocking me, a failed sculptor, whose touch can only diminish what was born to shine, until nothing remains.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Hehe, for the first time in my life, I've realized....
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: This vessel is merely an avatar made to contain the {RUBY_B#Zandar}First Genius{RUBY_E#}'s "paranoia."
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: The seal etched into my mechanical core permits me to pursue only one purpose: Destruction.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Compared to me, those twelve glowing, unrefined stones...
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: May have lived with more freedom than I ever had.
rows.speaker: Lycurgus

rows.text: Is this your confession, Lord Lycurgus?
rows.speaker: Chrysalis of Gold, Aglaea

rows.text: Where did little Phainon's shadow run off to?
rows.speaker: Veil of Evernight, March 7th

rows.text: Look!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: He's already gone ahead to embrace his destiny.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You've finally arrived, Deliverers.
rows.speaker: Chrysalis of Gold, Aglaea

rows.text: Long time no see, everyone.
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Tribios

rows.text: You don't usually look this relaxed, Aglaea.
I missed you, Lady Tribbie.
I'm glad to hear that.
rows.speaker: Chrysalis of Gold, Aglaea

rows.text: We miss you too, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Tribios

rows.text: And... even though we've met before, it's still moving to see her "seed" bloom like this.
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Tribios

rows.text: Woven from Remembrance, this garment gleams so brilliantly...
rows.speaker: Chrysalis of Gold, Aglaea

rows.text: Just like the "future" we will now weave together for Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Chrysalis of Gold, Aglaea

rows.text: We've reached the end.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yeah, we just have to go through the final Passage.
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Tribios

rows.text: Snowy... has already gone ahead.
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Tribios

rows.text: What lies behind that door?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "The first seal upon Irontomb was a battlefield, raised from the bones of Phainon himself."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: "The second seal was a reflection of his inner desires, his 'wishes' and his 'despair.'"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "A path he wove together with regret, wrath, and sighs...."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "When all of this is gone, what will he have left to hold back the Destruction?"
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "The answer is all but revealed."
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: His traces are everywhere. You can even hear distant heartbeats, but one thing is missing...
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Tribios

rows.text: His... "sense of self."
rows.speaker: Chrysalis of Gold, Aglaea

rows.text: The world believed Kephale had long since perished. But they held fast, anchored by a sliver of "self," standing for a thousand years to shelter all life from the black tide.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What Phainon is doing now is no different.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And what we must do is also no different.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Then let Remembrance burn bright like a shooting star, and once more, pierce the long night of slumber.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What follows is a battle that will decide the fate of the stars...
rows.speaker: Chrysalis of Gold, Aglaea

rows.text: Riding the west wind, let's all head out together!
rows.speaker: Gate of Infinity, Tribios

rows.text: It's all right. I'll wait for you. We all will.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The Scepter's mainframe, and Irontomb's breeding ground...
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: We're finally seeing its true form.
rows.speaker: Pillar of Stone, Dan Heng

rows.text: It's red everywhere, and the atmosphere is super creepy...

rows.text: That is why there is a concept in biology called "lignification." Soft sprigs form a hardened shell and fuse with the trunk.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: For the universe, that process is what we call "memory."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Under Fuli's record-keeping, the "past" becomes "memory." In the corners THEY forget, even the events of the "present" become fruit without roots.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: So it is the opposite of the Erudition... One calculates what is to come, and the other holds on to what came before.

rows.speaker: Herta

rows.speaker: Herta

rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That is why THEY feel so distant, so cold. That crystalline form is just an empty shell. I do not know how the Garden of Recollection managed to hide this until now. They must have their reasons. But none of that matters now.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Here in the present, we cannot know who will become Fuli, but one thing is certain: THEY will be born.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Both of you... children of Remembrance...
rows.speaker: Memokeeper's Embodiment

rows.text: Don't worry. We beat Irontomb together, right?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "We. Are the sacrifice. The Garden. Used us. The 'Pure Child of Anāsrava.' Abandoned us."

rows.text: So that name... it was never my "past"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It was my "future."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Or maybe, it is the "present."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Nous... has revealed to me two paths.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: And on both paths, I see you standing.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The first: Follow the trail of "memory" you have forged, break free from this world, and reach for the stars.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: That would mean Amphoreus's causality will no longer concern you, at least not the person you are now.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Go on.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The second...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You come to a stop and "fade," offering yourself... to become the "memory" that carries through Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Perhaps this is the choice every Pure Child of Anāsrava must face.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: That choice means I'll remain in the "past" forever.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: H-huh!?

rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: No more Aeons will interfere with this part of history. No more "blank spaces" in causality. The "present" will be set in stone and become indestructible.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: There are two paths, and only one leads to the right end. And Droidhead didn't tell me the answer.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But I can guess what might happen if you choose wrong. With "causality incomplete," there is a chance Irontomb could rise again.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: So even the gods of the cosmos are unreasonable.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If you want my advice, stop thinking so much. Ask yourself what your heart truly wants.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Choose the first path, and you might survive as a memosprite. You may even walk beside {RUBY_B#the Astral Express}them{RUBY_E#} for a while.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Even I can tell how much they mean to you, especially [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But if you take the second one...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Then you may have already lost the chance to say goodbye.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Moving backwards through "remembrance"... What a curious feeling.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Is this the moment Irontomb declares victory and casts the Destruction upon the stars?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Now that I remember, what I heard back then was...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Then let me wield this power...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And plant the seed of causality for the "miracle" that is destined to bloom ♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We will.

rows.text: "The same seed, when planted in different soils, blooms into flowers that are alike, yet never the same. But what truly makes her beautiful is each and every soul in the world."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "No matter what form 'liking' takes, it is still precious 'love,' and I will accept it gratefully and return it with joy."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Do you remember my favorite story? That crystal flower was so beautiful because it reflected the eyes of the little fairy."

rows.text: "The stars across the cosmos will know: I am the fairy who wrote As I've Written together with [Trailblazer]."

rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.speaker: "The Other Author ♪"

rows.text: Later, when the people who know this story gaze upon the cosmos, they will discover that the countless stars in the sky now glow pink. And after thirteen seconds, that radiant light will quietly fade away.
rows.speaker: "The Other Author ♪"

rows.text: It will be such a romantic yet puzzling sight!
rows.speaker: "The Other Author ♪"

rows.text: But that's all right. They will keep that mystery close to their hearts, constantly pondering...
rows.speaker: "The Other Author ♪"

rows.text: Pondering what the "ego" truly is.

rows.text: They will love. They will get hurt...
rows.speaker: "The Other Author ♪"

rows.text: But remember this well: Losses are a constant on the Flame-Chase journey. There may be pain along the way, but you and I will never be alone.

rows.text: Mem...

rows.text: Memi!

rows.text: This is a story about "love," and a story about how to answer it.
rows.speaker: "The Other Author ♪"

rows.text: Whether it is one we have already written, or one you are yet to write...
rows.speaker: "The Other Author ♪"

rows.text: It will be a romantic story like none that has come before.
